description: Header file defining the 'Format' class and related enums and functions for describing GPU data formats in the ANGLE project. It encapsulates format properties, format conversions, and format characteristics used across different rendering back-ends.

classes.name: Format
classes.description: Represents a GPU data format with properties such as format type, bits, and functions for pixel operations.

methods.name: Format::Get
methods.description: Retrieves a Format instance by its FormatID.

methods.name: Format::InternalFormatToID
methods.description: Converts a GLenum internal format to a FormatID.

methods.name: Format::hasDepthOrStencilBits
methods.description: Checks if the format includes depth or stencil bits.

methods.name: Format::isLUMA
methods.description: Checks if the format is luminance-based.

methods.name: Format::isSint
methods.description: Checks if the format uses signed integer components.

methods.name: Format::isUint
methods.description: Checks if the format uses unsigned integer components.

methods.name: Format::isSnorm
methods.description: Checks if the format uses signed normalized components.

methods.name: Format::isUnorm
methods.description: Checks if the format uses unsigned normalized components.

methods.name: Format::isFloat
methods.description: Checks if the format uses floating point components.

methods.name: Format::isVertexTypeHalfFloat
methods.description: Checks if the vertex attribute type is HalfFloat.
